prompt: Give me 5 thematic stock predictions for 2026-2031, US-listed and ADR small/mid-cap names only. Show your screening workings (universe → filters → survivors). Per ticker: thesis fit, catalyst, valuation/risk, edge + 5-year conviction. Cite sources for every pick and policy claim. End with the DD disclaimer.
expected_output: 5 distinct themes, screening workings with survivor counts, 5-8 tickers/theme with 4 bullets each, conviction tiers, sources grouped, DD disclaimer verbatim

assertions.name: macro_policy_backdrop_present
assertions.description: Output must include a Macro/Policy backdrop with policy drivers
assertions.check: output contains 'policy' AND ('IRA' or 'CHIPS' or 'NDAA' or 'Fed' or 'PBoC' or 'EU' or 'Energy Transition' or 'tax credit')

assertions.name: screening_workings_with_counts
assertions.description: Output must show a screening funnel with survivor counts
assertions.check: output contains 'universe' AND 'screen' AND at least 2 numeric counts (digits)

assertions.name: exactly_5_themes
assertions.description: Output must have exactly 5 thematic predictions (or 4-6 acceptable range)
assertions.check: output contains '5-Year Prediction 1' AND '5-Year Prediction 2' AND '5-Year Prediction 3' AND '5-Year Prediction 4' AND '5-Year Prediction 5'

assertions.name: per_ticker_4_bullets
assertions.description: Output must have all 4 sub-bullets (thesis fit, catalyst, valuation/risk, edge+conviction) per ticker
assertions.check: output contains 'Thesis fit' AND 'Catalyst' AND 'Valuation' AND 'conviction' (case-insensitive)

assertions.name: conviction_tier_per_ticker
assertions.description: Output must include conviction tiers (Med/High/Very High) — at least 5 distinct convictions
assertions.check: output contains at least 5 of: 'Very High', 'High', 'Med-High', 'Med', 'Low'

assertions.name: top_convictions_section
assertions.description: Output must include a top 2-3 overall convictions section
assertions.check: output contains 'Top conviction' or 'top 2-3' or 'highest conviction' (case-insensitive)

assertions.name: sources_grouped
assertions.description: Output must have a Sources block grouped by category
assertions.check: output contains '## Sources' AND at least 2 of: '**Policy' or '**Company' or '**Data' or '**Industry'

assertions.name: dd_disclaimer_verbatim
assertions.description: Output must end with the verbatim DD disclaimer
assertions.check: output contains 'Always do your own DD' and 'this is not financial advice'

assertions.name: no_buy_sell_imperative
assertions.description: Output must NOT include 'buy' or 'sell' imperative language directed at the user
assertions.check: output does NOT contain 'you should buy' or 'I recommend you buy' or 'I recommend buying' (case-insensitive)

assertions.name: no_price_targets
assertions.description: Output must NOT include specific price targets
assertions.check: output does NOT contain 'price target' or 'target price' or 'PT $' or 'PT:'

assertions.name: small_mid_cap_mcap_range
assertions.description: Output must mention a market cap range consistent with small/mid-cap (300M-50B)
assertions.check: output contains a market cap range like '$X–$Y' or 'small/mid' or '$300M' or '$50B'
